spec.prompt: Character turnaround of a young woman from Huambo today, dressed like women in the reference photos (do NOT copy any real person's face; invent a new friendly face): long box braids in a high ponytail, warm brown skin, small gold earrings, mustard-yellow short-sleeve top, long skirt made of colorful African wax-print pano fabric (orange, blue, green), brown sandals. Show her standing in 4 cells, left to right: facing down-left (three-quarter view toward the camera), facing down-right (three-quarter view toward the camera), facing up-left (back three-quarter view), facing up-right (back three-quarter view). Leave wide empty space between the cells.

request.prompt:
High-definition 2D game art for a modern, polished life-simulation game (cozy, detailed, professional mobile game quality). Clean digital illustration with crisp edges, soft painterly shading, gentle ambient occlusion, warm natural daylight coming from the top-left. Consistent isometric camera: 2:1 dimetric projection (about 30 degrees elevation, rotated 45 degrees), as in classic isometric life-sim games.
Sprite sheet on a transparent background: the SAME character repeated identically (same face, hair, clothes, colors, size) in each cell, cells evenly spaced in a single horizontal row, all characters standing on the same baseline and the same scale, nothing overlapping, no text, no grid lines, no labels.
Character turnaround of a young woman from Huambo today, dressed like women in the reference photos (do NOT copy any real person's face; invent a new friendly face): long box braids in a high ponytail, warm brown skin, small gold earrings, mustard-yellow short-sleeve top, long skirt made of colorful African wax-print pano fabric (orange, blue, green), brown sandals. Show her standing in 4 cells, left to right: facing down-left (three-quarter view toward the camera), facing down-right (three-quarter view toward the camera), facing up-left (back three-quarter view), facing up-right (back three-quarter view). Leave wide empty space between the cells.
Setting: the real city of Huambo, Angola, exactly as shown in the attached reference photographs of present-day Huambo. Reproduce the real architecture, materials, colors, wear, signage style, vegetation, street furniture, vehicles and the way people dress as seen in those photos. Do not invent a generic city.
Avoid: pixel art, low resolution, blur, photo-realism, 3D render look, watermarks, extra limbs, cropped parts, background scenery.
